audience: shop owners who run an online store on Imweb

useCases.title: Find orders waiting for payment
useCases.text: List orders by date range or status, then open one order to read its buyer, delivery address and items.

useCases.title: Add a tracking number to an order
useCases.text: Read the item order numbers of an order, then write the carrier code and tracking number. Imweb may notify the buyer.

useCases.title: Check sold-out products
useCases.text: List products filtered by status, such as sold out, and read the category codes of the shop.

useCases.title: Answer buyer questions about a product
useCases.text: List product inquiries that await an answer, then post an answer that the buyer can read.

useCases.title: Review reviews and coupons
useCases.text: List product reviews by rating or product, and the coupons of the shop with their discount and status.
